scope: Known OS vulnerabilities in the actual Azure VM installed-package inventory. Not a full filesystem, secret, runtime exploitability or running-kernel verification.
notes: No findings ignored, suppressed, reclassified as false positives or accepted by a recorded human exception.

The final selected findings are 1,549 package associations for 175 unique CVEs across nine kernel-source packages. Seven Azure packages have 173 associations each, and two common utility packages have 169 each.

The maintained Azure 6.8 packages are represented in vulnerability matching. The initial EOL 6.17 package stream was not reported equivalently; raw association counts are not a before/after measure of runtime exploitability.
No fixed version is supplied for these associations in this scanner/database result. Vendor status and per-advisory applicability require continuing review.

No selected-severity findings were reported for the other inventoried OS packages, including Nginx, Certbot, OpenSSL and Python cryptography. This is not a full host filesystem, secret or exploitability scan.
Thirteen reviewed obsolete 6.17 packages were removed only after a verified LTS boot. Azure LTS metapackages/integration were retained; another ordinary LTS boot and application persistence passed.
Final inventory export was completed after explicit user approval. Guest archive and downloaded SHA-256 and byte length match.
